[[File:MeatlumpKingDoll.jpg|200px|thumb|A Meatlump doll.]]
'''Newin Seedel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Seedel operated out of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] beneath [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. Seedel was an avid knitter, often times sewing together various items, while sometimes performing [[Doctor/Legends|surgeries]] for gang members. Seedel used to sew together pieces of dolls resembling members of the Meatlump Gang, including the [[Meatlump King]] himself.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateMeatlump.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Newin Seedel]]
Newin Seedel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Newin Seedel was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref> During each server reset, Seedel's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and appearance was randomized, but Seedel consistently appeared as a Human.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

By switching the first letters in Seedel's first and last name, the name appears like Sewin Needel, similar in spelling to sewing needle. This would appear to be a reference to the fact that Newin Seedel's primary function was to sew things together.
